sharedRules.name: Phase Out
sharedRules.description: If a necron army is ever reduced to 25% or less of its original number of models it will disappear from the battlefield automatically losing the game. C’tan, Spyder, Scarab, Pariahs, and Monoliths do not count for this. This is calculated after We’ll be back.

sharedRules.name: We'll Be back
sharedRules.description:
When a necron model is reduced to 0 wounds lay it facedown. Damaged models are ignored for coherency and cannot be attacked. This cannot be done if killed by a close combat weapon that ignores armor saves or by an attack that was double the targets toughness. In addition, another model of the same type must be within 6” though not of the same unit.
At the start of the necron turn roll 1d6 for each necron capable of self-repairing. Ona 4-6 the necron stands back up with 1 wound remaining. Place within coherency of the nearest unit of the same type. The model now acts as if it was part of that unit. If the unit was in close combat it joins the melee but may not be placed in contact with a new enemy unit.

You then reduce the number of dice in that pool by a number equal to the Wounds characteristic of the Reanimated model and repeat this process until either there are no more reassembling models, or the number of dice remaining in the pool is less than the Wounds characteristic of any of the reassembling models. Any models that did not Reanimate fail to reassemble, and any dice remaining in the pool are discarded.

Necron lord:
Necron lords do not need a model of the same type within 6” unless killed by a close combat weapon that ignores armor saves or by an attack that was double the targets toughness.

Tomb Spyder:
Necron do not need a model of the same type within 6” if there is a spyder within 12”.

rules.name: Ponderous
rules.description: This model is a skimmer that can move up to 6" or remain stationary if it chooses. It will not drift if stunned or shaken and if immobilised it will not crash but instead sink slowly to the ground. When this model deep strikes if enemy models are within 1" instead of being destroyed move those models the minimum distance required to make space for the monolith.

rules.name: Power Matrix
rules.description:
The monolith may use one of the following abilities each Necron turn
1:In the shooting phase use the Particle whip profile


2:In the movement phase allow a unit with the Necron rule and any joined lord with at least one model within 18" of the monolith to be removed from the table (even if in close combat) and re-emerge from the front of the monolith. If a unit of warrior can come into play then you must use this ability even if you would prefer to fire the Particle whip and must select the warrior unit to enter play. Only one warrior unit may enter play through each monolith per turn. Any models that failed their We'll Be Back roll at the start of the turn and where removed may try again when the unit emerges from the monolith.
